mapper.select: SELECT * FROM market_activity WHERE status = #{status} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY start_time DESC
SELECT * FROM market_activity WHERE status = 'NOT_STARTED' AND start_time > NOW() AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY start_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ma.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booth b WHERE b.event_id = ma.id AND b.deleted = 0) AS booth_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vendor_application va WHERE va.event_id = ma.id AND va.status = 'PENDING' AND va.deleted = 0) AS pending_applications_count FROM market_activity ma WHERE ma.id = #{id} AND ma.deleted = 0
